packageRules.description: Automerge safe update types. GitHub does the merge itself the moment the required check goes green, so this no longer waits for the next daily Renovate run
Pre-1.0 software uses the minor slot for breaking changes; those wait for review
Majors stay manual and get flagged; the Dependency Dashboard issue lists them per repo
Callers ride the shared workflows at @master by design; never pin or update those refs
svelte-check cannot typecheck under TypeScript 7 yet; lift once the Svelte toolchain supports it
